name: purple-studio-fashion-portrait
image_vibe: Composed polished black styling against a saturated purple studio with warm beauty accents
image_purpose: Create a modern fashion editorial portrait for lookbook or campaign use.

prompt.project_info: A vertical 3:4 medium studio fashion portrait of an original adult woman seated against a smooth purple backdrop.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with light-to-medium brown skin, an oval face, black hair slicked back with a center part, a soft confident expression, and direct eye contact. She wears a black cropped collared top with a front zipper, long puff sleeves, a fitted torso, a thin silver metallic band just below the bust, thin black wrap-style waist straps, and matte structured high-waisted black pants with gold hoop earrings.
prompt.composition_elements: Seated medium portrait with one knee raised in the foreground, upper body slightly leaned forward, right hand resting under the chin, left arm across the lap, slightly tilted head, sharp focus on face and upper body, and smooth seamless purple background with subtle tonal variation.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Front-facing soft studio light with balanced controlled shadows and gentle highlights on forehead, cheeks, and nose, polished confident modern-fashion mood, saturated purple environment.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 3:4 medium portrait, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, sharp face and upper body, photorealistic high-resolution detail, natural skin texture and fabric detail, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical 3:4 medium studio fashion portrait of an original adult woman with light-to-medium brown skin, an oval face, black hair slicked back with a center part, a soft confident expression, and direct eye contact. Seat her with one knee raised in the foreground, upper body slightly leaned forward, right hand resting under the chin, left arm across the lap, and head slightly tilted. Dress her in a black cropped collared top with a front zipper, long puff sleeves, a fitted torso, a thin silver metallic band just below the bust, thin black wrap-style waist straps, matte structured high-waisted black pants, and gold hoop earrings. Use a smooth seamless solid purple backdrop with subtle tonal variation, front-facing soft studio light, balanced controlled shadows, gentle highlights on the face, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, realistic skin and fabric texture, subtle film grain, polished modern fashion-editorial clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed clothing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source purple studio fashion portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for purple backdrop, black cropped outfit, raised-knee seated pose, hand-under-chin gesture, and polished studio lighting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult subject, black outfit construction, gold hoops, purple seamless studio, seated composition, and composed fashion mood. Identity and non-essential details may vary.
